items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: He was born to do what he do. Like when I got in the band, he had five trumpets.

ctx.x: He was born with that. I saw him when I was thirteen years old. His mother and father would escort him at the Crystal Beach you know, with his band you see? You follow me? He had it. But everybody else who finally heard him, assumed whatever they wanted to assume, of how he got that way. He was born to do what he do. Like when I got in the band, he had five trumpets.
And they were trying to beat Maynard. And they’re trying to beat every note.
